profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cardinal Health
profile.summary: I am an alumni of Tech Elevator and I've always believed that technology should exist to help and uplift our surroundings. Having worked in the long-term care pharmacy arena for years, I've witnessed how invaluable technology can be as well as how devastating an impact its absence and shortcomings can have on a patient. I became consumed and impassioned to discover and explore the different avenues in which technology can used as a preventative measure to not only reduce adverse outcomes but also be a tool to stretch our boundaries and further our environment.

positions.title: Java Development Bootcamp Student
positions.description:
Currently enrolled as a Java bootcamp student at Tech Elevator.  Below is a list of projects I’ve completed during my time here:

Capstone Project I - Catering Vendor application
My team and I developed a Java application using Object Oriented Programming that integrated a customer/user account that allowed them to order catering products from their computers

Capstone Project II - Excelsior Venues Reservation application
Developed a Java application using the DAO pattern that allowed users to submit venue and venue space reservations that were logged to a database

Capstone Project III - Tenmo Online Payment Service
Developed a command line application and RESTful API server that functioned as an online payment service that allowed money transfers between users

positions.title: Lead IV Technician/ Data Entry Tech (Certified and Registered)
positions.description:
• Processed IV orders though a specialized clinical computer program 
• Prepared medications for intravenous administration as well as sterile topical solutions using aseptic technique while  following strict USP 797 standards and procedures 
• Performed daily IV room cleaning and monthly full deep cleanings 
• Recorded daily logs of IV clean room temperature and humidity, IV drug room temp, IV clean room/ante room pressure  and refrigerator/freezer temps 
• Processed prescription orders received via fax, email, or the electronic PointClickCare system at a minimum rate of 30  orders/hr 
• Triaged incoming faxes and orders into appropriate folders and queues 
• Created new profiles for our newly admitted long-term care patients in our computer database
• Updated patient records electronically through Pharmerica’s AS400 software program

positions.title: Pharmacy Technician
positions.description:
• Interacted with customers and provided answers to inquiries while relaying health related questions to pharmacists 
• Prepared and packaged medications to be checked by pharmacists before distribution 
• Executed computer entry tasks such as; processing prescriptions, inputting private patient information, updating patient  profiles, performing medication reconciliation to document any issues in duplication and/or drug interactions
 • Performed maintenance of pharmacy facility that included; removing expired products, maintaining equipment e.g. printers  and scanners, obtaining and stocking supplies and making orders to achieve proper inventory levels
